liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Dark Star** (4 reviews): Jerry sounds half asleep most of the show but wakes up for a brilliant Dark Star; Second set run from Estimated Prophet through Dark Star is a favorite, with a seamless move into a telepathic Other One [11][13][17][20]
- **Jack Straw** (2 reviews): Jerry wakes up with a blazing Jack Straw, and returns from the break with more energy; First set is just okay, with a good Jack Straw [12][13]
- **The Promised Land** (1 review): Opening Promised Land has fragile, pleasing Jerry work but isn't a roaring version [15]
- **Sugaree** (1 review): Reviewer finds Sugaree a snoozer with quiet, mellow Garcia solos, though the final chorus builds steam [15]
- **It's All Over Now** (1 review): Reviewer recalls It's All Over Now, Not Fade Away and the Saturday Night encore standing out [14]
- The first long solo break is outstanding and moving, a top Jerry moment [18]

## Setlist highlights

- **The Other One Reprise**: back after 475 archived shows (2715 days); rare: 3 archived performances [21]

## The recordings

- **gd1979-01-20.aud.claridge.wise.312.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): audience recording; 24 songs; 178 min; rated 5/5 by 2 [1]
- **gd1979-01-20.nak700.moore.bertha.100025.flac16**: source not stated; 23 songs; 164 min; rated 3.94/5 by 18 [2]
- **gd79-01-20.naks.moore.12575.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 22 songs; 165 min; rated 3.71/5 by 21 [3]. Said about its sound: Above-average to excellent audience recording; Magnificent audience recording, among the best of several excellent tapes made that chilly night; Amazingly clear sound, though vocals are quiet at times [11][17][20]
- **gd1979-01-20.110977.nak700-moore.berger.flac24**: audience recording; 21 songs; 166 min [4]

## Around the show

- Audience can be heard shouting for Truckin', which the band didn't play; some funny crowd comments [11]
- Donna Jean was gone; vocals were rough at times as the band adjusted to no backing singers [12]
- Reviewer attributes the sequence's otherness to moon phases, Donna's absence, or the beautiful Sheas theater [13]
- Freezing cold Saturday night; reviewer sat in the balcony of the old-fashioned theater, feeling right over the band [14]
- Donna did not play this night [15]
- Theater is ornate and opulent, like a king's palace, reminiscent of a church in Rome [16]
- Many tapers attended on a chilly night; reviewer finds the rest of the performance lackluster [17]
- Entire show without Donna Jean Godchaux; it started almost two hours late [4]
- Regarded as one of the better shows of this winter tour [9]
- Only two Dark Stars played all year in 1979, and the other, on 1-10, was with Donna [20]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1979-01-20.aud.claridge.wise.312.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Eddie Claridge; transferred by Jim Wise; source: Sony ECM-280 mics > Sony tc158 > FOB Cass. Master [1]
- **gd1979-01-20.nak700.moore.bertha.100025.flac16**: taped by Jerry Moore; transferred by Charlie Miller and Jay Ashley; source: (FOB/6th Row) Nakamichi 700 (Sony D5/Dolby B) -> Cassette Master -> Dat -> CD -> FLAC [2]. Also: Remaster of an earlier transfer, pitch-corrected with Joe B. Jones's help, done on the Bertha workstation, completed 7/3/2009 [2]
- **gd79-01-20.naks.moore.12575.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Jerry Moore; transferred by Mark Cohen, Noah Weiner; source: Audience Recording: NAK 700's [3]. Also: Reviewer believes the NAK mics and Sony deck listed reflect the DAT conversion chain, not the 1979 taping setup [9]
- **gd1979-01-20.110977.nak700-moore.berger.flac24**: taped by Jerry Moore; transferred by Rob Berger; source: source: aud cassette master taped by Jerry Moore from 6th row center; [4]. Also: Tape flips occur during Good Lovin' and the Drums to Other One transition [4]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Poster - Shea's Buffalo Theatre](https://www.dead.net/archives/1979/artwork/poster-sheas-buffalo-theatre) [22]
- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Shea's Buffalo Theatre - January 20, 1979](https://www.dead.net/show/january-20-1979) [23]
- Poster by Marsia Tunis Grateful Dead: [1979-01-20 Shea's Buffalo Theater, Buffalo, NY, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1979-01-20-sheas-buffalo-theater-buffalo-ny-usa/) [24]
